description: This file defines an interface for an HTTP client conforming to PSR-18, providing a method to send HTTP requests and receive responses.

classes.name: ClientInterface
classes.description: An interface defining the method for sending PSR-7 HTTP requests and receiving responses.

methods.description: Sends a PSR-7 request and returns a PSR-7 response, potentially throwing a ClientExceptionInterface if an error occurs.
